description.fun: The legendary hero of Pokémon Shield, a wolf that worked with a king of the people to save Galar long ago, then slept as a statue for so long that everyone forgot it existed. It was known as the Fighting Master's Shield, able to deflect any attack. An unstoppable sword facing an unbreakable shield makes Zacian and Zamazenta a living version of the irresistible force paradox.
description.guide: The Fighting-type Legendary Pokémon on the cover of Pokémon Shield and Zacian's counterpart. Holding the Rusted Shield, it becomes the Fighting and Steel-type Crowned Shield Zamazenta.
description.tagline: The shield-bearing wolf hero of Pokémon Shield

description.fun: Equipped with its shield, Zamazenta shrugs off tremendous blows, even the attacks of Dynamax Pokémon. It can turn its whole body into a shield and slam into its foes, and it's said to bore holes through mountains.
